name: Travel planning
description: Check and budget a trip from an itinerary CSV, and build a packing list. Columns are found by name: type (flight, train, hotel ... in several languages), description, from, to, start (departure, check-in), end (arrival, check-out), start offset and end offset (UTC offsets such as +02:00), amount, currency, category. Check finds unreadable dates, items that end before they start, impossible connections (an arrival after the next departure), tight connections under a limit you set, lodging overlaps and nights with no lodging, and gives every duration as real elapsed time when UTC offsets are present; Budget totals by day, category and currency with the exchange rates YOU supply (nothing is looked up); Packing builds a deduplicated list from the trip length, the climate and the activities. Arithmetic on your own bookings, not travel advice: check visa, health and entry rules with the official sources. The original is never changed.

presets.label: Check the itinerary
presets.description: Unreadable dates and items ending before they start (error), impossible connections (error), tight connections under 60 minutes (warning; change it with min=45 in the extra arguments), lodging overlaps and uncovered nights (warning), a table of durations in real elapsed time when UTC offsets are given. Problems come back as file(line), with Fix with agent.

presets.label: Budget by day, category and currency
presets.description: Totals each currency as written; with base=EUR rates=USD=0.92,GBP=1.17 in the extra arguments (1 USD = 0.92 EUR, your own rates) also totals by category and by day in the base currency. Lodging is spread over its nights. Lines with no rate are listed, never guessed.

presets.label: Packing list
presets.description: A deduplicated checklist from the trip length (from the itinerary dates, a phrase such as "7 days", or days=7 in the extra arguments), the climate (climate=cold, hot, rain, mild, or words in the file) and the activities (activities=hiking,beach,ski,business,camping,city,formal). Items already ticked as checkboxes in the file are not repeated.
